title: KazooCon 2019
html:
The next KazooCon takes place in San Diego, CA, USA, during June 18-20, 2019. This is the event organized by 2600hz company for their open source telephony platform project Kazoo. The project incorporates Kamailio, which includes a module named kazoo that facilitates the integration with the web management interface and the API systems.

Therefore expect to meet a lot of people very familiar with Kamailio, many of them being among the active developers and community members. If you are in the hosted PBX business, this is an event that you should attend. For more details, visit:

  • https://kazoocon.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
